reward_bonuses.weekly_provenance: Explicit deterministic local table, not the official random egg/dust table; replace with a reviewed operator table. Distance is validated foreground walking; external Health/Google Fit ingestion is not implemented.

notes: Daily and seven-day XP: Pokemon GO GO Beyond update 2020-12-07, https://pokemongo.com/news/gobeyond-level40
Daily dust and calendar behavior: https://niantic.helpshift.com/hc/en/6-pokemon-go/faq/105-daily-bonuses/ (its XP table predates the GO Beyond update).
Extra spin item counts are explicit custom local tuning. Species candy/dust bonuses come from supplied Game Master encounter fields10/11.
Events are bounded start_ms/end_ms with xp,dust,candy factors. Native throw thresholds remain those of existing ENCOUNTER_SETTINGS.
